Jordan / team —

We do not require a full novation for this kind of acquisition unless the underlying contract obligates third-party consent (rare for this account based on last review). Process to follow:

1) For outstanding invoices dated on or before the closing date (please confirm closing date), issue final invoice to Zenwell Health and mark as "final before acquisition" in our ledger.
2) For invoices with service dates after the closing/cutover date, issue to HorizonCare Ltd with the billing address and VAT number you provided.
3) Documentation: we need either:
   - Signed transfer/assignment form that authorizes HorizonCare to receive invoices and accept billing terms, or
   - PO amendment from the buyer that explicitly states billing + remittance should be directed to HorizonCare (DocuSign acceptable).
4) Tax/VAT: please ask HorizonCare to provide a VAT registration certificate (or confirmation via government portal) so we can attach the VAT reference. If HorizonCare is UK-registered, we will show VAT as a separate line item and include their VAT ID in the invoice header.

Please find a simple transfer template attached (tax_cert_request_form.docx) — edit as needed. Marcus, if Legal wants to swap to a short assignment, happy to review. Priya, once we have the signed doc and VAT cert, Collections will update the remittance instructions and reissue any invoice that needs switching.

I'll prepare the accounting entries and set the cutover in our billing system once we receive the signed transfer and VAT docs.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director of Finance, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: tax_cert_request_form.docx (template)
